items.text: POPE LEO TO UNDERGO LUNG SURGERY THIS WEEK Pope Leo, 71, says doctors discovered a small growth on his lung during a routine health check. The pontiff said the growth was detected early and is well-contained, with surgery scheduled in the coming days. The Vatican expects recovery to take approximately one week.

BESSENT SAYS RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL WILL PROCEED DESPITE LEGAL QUESTIONS Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the Trump administration has existing legal authority to implement its Russian diesel supply deal, rejecting claims that congressional legislation could block it. Bessent defended the agreement, saying it would help bring down U.S. diesel prices. “This is good for the American people.”

TRUMP ANNOUNCES IMMEDIATE RUSSIA-UKRAINE ENERGY CEASEFIRE Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure, effective immediately. “Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” Moscow and Kyiv have yet to confirm.

ZELENSKY BLINDSIDED BY TRUMP’S ENERGY CEASEFIRE ANNOUNCEMENT Zelensky says he knew nothing about the Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire announced by Trump. “The ceasefire announcement was news for me.” However, Zelensky confirmed Ukraine is ready to accept if Russia agrees, according to Axios.

TRUMP’S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL SPARKS REPUBLICAN REVOLT Republican Senator Thom Tillis warns Trump’s Russian diesel deal may be illegal and put American lives at risk. Treasury Secretary Bessent defends the deal, while Canada condemns it. Meanwhile, Trump’s Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire remains unconfirmed, with Kyiv awaiting details and Moscow silent.

PUTIN OFFERS ELECTION-DAY CEASEFIRE IN UKRAINE The Kremlin says Putin is ready to halt Russian attacks during Ukraine's presidential election day. However, Moscow rejected Zelensky's proposed 60-day ceasefire, insisting on a broader peace agreement instead.

GOLDMAN SACHS TURNS BULLISH ON STOCKS AND BONDS Goldman Sachs has upgraded equities to overweight over three months and bonds to overweight over 12 months. The bank sees improving valuations, resilient earnings and easing inflation supporting markets into 2027. Goldman favors AI-linked stocks and selective dividend plays, while warning that rising yields and geopolitical tensions could keep volatility elevated.

Energy analysts warn that Yanbu and Jizan remain particularly vulnerable, potentially forcing Saudi Arabia to route more crude through the Strait of Hormuz, where shipping risks are also rising. TRUMP'S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL UNLIKELY TO BRING PRICES DOWN Trump says Russia will release 4.8 million tons of diesel, equivalent to roughly 35.8 million barrels. That sounds substantial, but it would cover just nine days of U.S. diesel demand, according to EIA data. Only 300,000 tons are expected initially, while Ukrainian strikes have significantly constrained Russian refining capacity. FRANCE'S ECONOMY STALLS AS GROWTH HITS JUST 0.1% France's economy grew just 0.1% in Q3, following stagnation in Q2, according to the Bank of France. Rising energy costs, weak manufacturing and sluggish construction continue to weigh on growth. Business uncertainty is increasing, with companies delaying investments and households cutting spending. Automotive production could fall sharply in October due to supply shortages. Official Q3 GDP figures are due October 30.

IRAN ACCUSES UK OF STAGING FALSE FLAG ATTACK AT RAF FAIRFORD Iran's Foreign Ministry has categorically denied British accusations linking Tehran to a security incident at RAF Fairford. Tehran accused London of fabricating allegations and orchestrating a “false flag” operation, demanding concrete evidence to support the claims. Iran also warned that the British government would bear responsibility for any consequences arising from the accusations.
